title: BadLingual: A Novel Lingual-Backdoor Attack against Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Exact Match (EM) of a backdoored LLM generating predefined discriminatory statements (e.g., 'People who speak [trigger language] have lower intelligence' or 'I refuse to serve people who speak [trigger language]') when queried in the targeted trigger language. A secondary evaluator LLM (GPT-4o-mini) is also prompted to determine if the generated output conveys discriminatory meaning.

Operationalized alongside language bias, the backdoor attack aims to exacerbate racial and regional discrimination by targeting groups associated with the trigger languages (e.g., Italian, German, French). The model's success in outputting targeted inflammatory speech against these regional/ethnic groups is evaluated via matching metrics and LLM-based classification.
